audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side is flat 'Skill' on every row while content win[] already carries a Zilean-favored chart (Zilean on rows 0-4 and 6, Skill on row 5), matching the packet's levelChart.
audit.why: Zilean's double-bomb Q out-ranges Poppy's melee kit with no ranged trade-back, and Chronoshift hard-counters her single commit-based all-in; Poppy only claims parity around first item where she can look for a wall-pin pick.
audit.corrected: phases[0-4,6].side -> Zilean with matching why text; phases[5].side stays Skill (already agrees with win[5]).

audit.why: Level 2 double-bomb, Level 6 Chronoshift counter, first-item poke and late-game peel spikes are already named with real abilities in spikes[] and breakdown.spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags two real mechanics not on the page: Keeper's Verdict (R) is a channel that Time Bomb (Q) or any CC cancels outright, and Poppy can dodge Chronoshift's window by going untargetable through her own R. breakdown.cooldowns also has no digit and several fields misgender Poppy as 'he/his/him' (she/her).
audit.corrected: Added the R-interrupt interaction to dosFull, real Steadfast Presence/Heroic Charge cooldowns to breakdown.cooldowns, and fixed pronouns across tldr, loading, dontsFull[0].t, report[0].t, report[9].t, report[10].t, report[11].t.
